description:
The West End - Peaceful living in the Music City

The space
Welcome to The Music City! This peaceful home is located in the wonderful West End neighborhood, on the border of Midtown, Music Row, The Parthenon, and Hillsboro Village. Downtown/Broadway is a very short drive away! 

No parties!
No locals!

Amenities include:
· 2 King Beds
· 1 Queen over Queen bunk bed
· 2 side by side queen beds
· Hassle-free, keyless check-in
· Double-wide driveway
· Smart TV
· High-speed internet
· Grill
· Washer/Dryer
· Fully equipped kitchen with appliances, glasses & dishware for all your cooking needs
· Keurig coffee maker
· French Press
· Hair dryers, shampoo, conditioner, & body wash provided
· Linens and towels provided
· Spacious closets

My wife and I are locals and love this city! Message us if you have any questions about the property or would like some suggestions for fun things to do/great places to eat while you're in town! 

By booking with us, you are supporting a small, local, family business! :) 

We do not host locals and will require all of our guests to send a photo of their ID upon booking for insurance reasons. Please keep this in mind when booking. We are legally unable to host anyone under the age of 21.

-Joe
